import gpxpy
import json
from io import StringIO

# Minimal valid GPX content
gpx_xml = '''<?xml version="1.0"?><gpx>
  <wpt lat="40.7486" lon="-73.9864"><name>Empire State</name><ele>44</ele></wpt>
  <trk><name>Central Park Loop</name><trkseg>

    <trkpt lat="40.7765" lon="-73.9730"><ele>35</ele></trkpt>

</gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(StringIO(gpx_xml))

    "waypoints": [
        {"name": w.name, "lat": w.latitude, "lon": w.longitude, "ele": w.elevation}

        {

        }
        for t in gpx.tracks
    ]
}

print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
